mapper.select: SELECT co.*, c.name as courseName, c.course_no as courseNo, t.name as teacherName, s.name as semesterName, c.credits as credits, c.category as category FROM course_offer co LEFT JOIN course c ON co.course_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN teacher t ON co.teacher_id = t.id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN semester s ON co.semester_id = s.id WHERE co.deleted = 0 AND co.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY co.create_time DESC
